desc:
This version of Dragon Ball R is now discontinued, as we are remaking the game from the ground up.
DRAGON BALL R's REWORK PLAYTEST IS OUT, GO PLAY IT: https://www.roblox.com/games/16079660537/DRAGON-BALL-R

The objective of this game is to remake Dragon Ball N, but continue and improve the work of the original. This game does NOT specifically support controllers! While you may be able to play with one, certain things won't work. Plugging in a keyboard and mouse may make your experience more pleasant. 
If you want in-game gamepasses, go to the original Dragon Ball N. The gamepasses there transfer to this game. 


Developers and active contributors working on the game: 
minocrafting - Scripter, Animator 
MJPR1CE - Animator, Rigger, SFX Design
TreetopYes - VFX designer 
xuq92 - VFX designer, Animator 
AIbou1 - vfx contributor
Chilldillpickles123 - Thumbnail Artist
 

DATA DOES NOT SAVE IN PRIVATE SERVER. MEANT TO BE FOR HAVING FUN W/ FRIENDS & HOSTING TOURNAMENTS.
